scenes.say: We have a crime to report. This team scored seventy eight points, and almost won.
scenes.headline: WEEK 6

scenes.say: Givin Me A Chubb. Missed his projection by forty two. His tight end scored zero. Meltdown and choke of the week.
charges: Meltdown AND Choke of the Week

scenes.say: And he still only lost by one point eight four. A waiver pickup beat the spread.
Meanwhile, Allen Key Set benched sixteen and a half points. Guilty.
Team Solari won by thirty one. No survivors.
And our app wrote all of this. About our league. Every single week.
scenes.text: Six games, 109.9 points a team, and somehow three different guys won with a waiver pickup that outscored their entire margin of victory. Let's start with the carnage. 78.8 — dead last, missed his projection by 42.7, which is both Meltdown and Choke of the Week, the fantasy equivalent of getting flagged twice for the same play.
scenes.highlight: the fantasy equivalent of getting flagged twice for the same play
